request_payload.title: Disease-linked mutations in Munc18-1 deplete synaptic Doc2.

mentions.sentence: Heterozygous de novo mutations in the neuronal protein Munc18-1/STXBP1 cause syndromic neurological symptoms, including severe epilepsy, intellectual disability, developmental delay, ataxia and tremor, summarized as STXBP1 encephalopathies.

candidates.label: EMG: decremental response of compound muscle action potential to repetitive nerve stimulation

mentions.sentence: Using biochemical and cell biological readouts on mouse brains, cultured mouse neurons and heterologous cells, we found that the synaptic Munc18-1 interactors Doc2A and Doc2B are unstable in the absence of Munc18-1 and aggregate in the presence of disease-causing Munc18-1 mutants.
